table_comment: Best-effort configuration history for explicitly registered public tables. INSERT records the configuration baseline; UPDATE records only normalized configuration differences. Campaign snapshots exclude log, timestamps, status, claims and known runtime progress; auto_error excludes created_at/updated_at. Historical V382 rows may contain full source snapshots and are retained. table_name has no schema prefix. Admin-only read; no automatic retention, source FKs, DELETE logging or backfill. Rolled-back writes leave no log.
function_comment: AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE FOR EACH ROW trigger for supported public source tables, excluding auto_table_logs. TG_ARGV[0] is the configuration profile (campaign_config_v1 or error_config_v1); TG_ARGV[1..] are primary-key column names included in the profile snapshot. Registrations: auto_campaigns -> ('campaign_config_v1','id'); auto_error -> ('error_config_v1','id'). INSERT captures configuration; UPDATE skips unchanged normalized configuration. Owner-only SECURITY DEFINER with fixed search_path; ordinary capture errors are skipped with a sanitized warning, without retry. No human-actor attribution.
